title: Romeo Santos Launches Fundación Los Santos to Support Children With Autism & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music
summary: Plus, Eladio Carrión brings Saucegiving back to Puerto Rico, and Rosalía honors Caetano Veloso and Fito Páez in Rio.
body: From career milestones to new releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week. Romeo Santos Launches Fundación Los Santos to Support Children With Autism Romeo Santos is turning a very personal experience into a broader mission. On Tuesday (Aug. 11), the bachata superstar announced the launch of Fundación Los Santos, a registered 501(c)(3) organization created to support children with autism and their families through greater access to resources, educational opportunities, developmental programs and community initiatives. “As a father of a child with autism, I have experienced firsthand both the joys and challenges that many families face every day,” Santos said in a statement. “The Los Santos Foundation seeks to help families feel seen, supported and empowered, contributing to a more hopeful future for so many children.” With a personal contribution from Santos, the foundation’s initial efforts will focus on grants, strategic partnerships, family resource centers, social and developmental opportunities for children,…

title: Here Are Events Marc Anthony, Feid, Karol G & More Latin Music Artists Are Joining in Support of Colombia and Venezuela Earthquake Relief
summary: Benefit concerts are set to take place during the weekend of Aug. 15-16.
body: While Colombia grapples with the aftermath of its highest-magnitude earthquake recorded in the 21st century, the music industry is mobilizing to support relief efforts. Artists in the United States and Colombia are joining forces, using their influence and music to raise funds for organizations and communities that need support in rebuilding cities and assisting families in need.  Related Everything You Need to Know About the Unidos Por Los Nuestros Benefit Concert: Donations, Artists & How to Watch How to Help Those Impacted by the Earthquakes in Colombia Shakira, Maluma, Camilo & More Bring Attention to Earthquake in Colombia: ‘We Need Strength and Union’ Colombian artists including Maluma, Karol G, Feid and Carlos Vives and artists from other countries such as Puerto Rico, Cuba and Venezuela are participating in events and fundraisers, or simply using their nonprofits and social media for visibility and assistance as Colombia and Venezuela recover from devastating earthquakes. summary: A complete rundown of the most important events across the music business.
body: As part of our continuing efforts to serve the music industry and its creators, Billboard Pro now features a music industry events calendar for readers. The calendar will act as music’s most complete summary major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals to networking mixers and more. Just as Billboard is music’s must-read source for news, charts and analysis, now it also is the go-to for business happenings. There are enough K-pop concerts and world tours this year to make keeping track of who’s touring where a challenge. As the genre becomes more popular in the States and across the globe, artists have begun expanding their horizons, taking their tours beyond Asia to stop in North America and beyond. That’s not even including the K-pop acts headlining music festivals and conventions that are taking place this year. On the docket for 2026, we’re already seeing big names embarking on massive world tours and even Las Vegas residencies, like BLACKPINK’s Lisa’s Viva La Lisa .
